semantics: Synthetic nonminimal proposal wrapper from the existing typed value vector, converted using actual toGovActionState and fromGovActionState. Copy the helper to probe/ProposalRoundtrip.hs and input TSV to proposal-roundtrip-input.tsv; add an executable like scls-canonical-vectors with this main file.
